criteria.requirement: Add immutable formatter.SUPPORTED_OPTIONS for actual supported input keys and validate_options(options,strict=False); expose opt-in sqlparse.format(...,strict_options=True). Strict mode rejects every unknown key including None values, lists all offenders and offers deterministic nearest real-key suggestions. Require a real bool strict flag and keep existing known-value/combination validation. Default remains compatible and tolerant of extras, including current CLI filename/outfile/inplace metadata; do not accidentally enable strict over vars(args). Internal computed indent_char is not a public input option. Do not add speculative filters or silently accept a registration key that has no real implementation.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
